bullets_en: Family of Hyderabad man detained in Russia seeks MEA intervention.

Imphal faces highest earthquake shaking hazard among 8 NE cities: IIT study.
HYDRAA restores Sunna Cheruvu, lake set for inauguration.

bullets_ur: Russia mein nazarband Hyderabad ke shakhs ke khandan ki MEA se mudakhlat ki appeal.

NE ke 8 shahron mein Imphal sab se ziyada zalzala khazay ki zad par: IIT ki tehqeeq.

Har mustahiq ghareeb khandan ko Indiramma ghar milega: Ponguleti.
